name: Three-pass same-build seminar rehearsal freeze
trigger: Run the real seven-scene seminar verdict three times in one isolated sim world with the same build id, then submit a changed build with and without an owner receipt.
observe: three passes persisted across a world-store reload
a later same-build failure does not release the freeze
an unapproved build change is refused before rehearsal
a matching owner approval records the next build and starts its pass count
expected: The third consecutive same-build pass freezes the rehearsal state; a changed build is refused until a matching owner approval receipt is supplied.
